headline: Hannover Re Targets €2.9 Billion Profit Despite Falling Reinsurance Prices
summary: Hannover Re expects to generate €2.9 billion in profit and aims to further increase sales in 2027 despite facing headwinds from falling reinsurance pricing.
why: Hannover Re is one of the world's largest reinsurance companies, providing loss-absorption capacity to primary insurers globally.

impacts.name: Hannover Rück SE
impacts.why: Strong profit guidance indicates resilient underwriting performance despite pricing pressures.
